explication: htmgo is a Go framework and toolchain for building interactive, server-rendered websites with htmx. Its principal workflow is to define pages and partials in Go, register routes, handle requests through the framework, and render HTML responses; the CLI supports project setup and development workflows. Separate branches cover WebSocket interactions, HTML-to-Go conversion, and the project’s own website. Some subsystems are represented from README or source-index references because their implementation excerpts were not provided; edges are limited to documented or visible relationships.
